verification_audit.method: Compared current repository research coverage with Xenoverse 2-specific skill documentation and independent documentation.

records.name: Deadly Dance
records.character_source: Android 18 / Android 18 (DB Super) / Krillin customizable partner / Android 17 (DB Super) customizable partner / Kefla (Super Saiyan) customizable partner
records.skill_description: A close-range series of dance-like kicks that repels weak Ki Blasts during the sequence and ends by launching the opponent upward.
records.mechanics_notes: The Xenoverse 2 skill reference describes a five-hit kick sequence with Ki Blast deflection and a launching somersault kick. The opponent remains airborne after the launch, allowing follow-up attacks.
records.acquisition_notes: Canonical documented acquisition is Android 18's second training lesson. No Parallel Quest or Ultimate Finish requirement is asserted.
records.pve_notes: Mentor-training acquisition; no exact drop probability applies.
records.pvp_notes: Strike combo tool with Ki Blast-deflecting behavior and launch; detailed frame and recovery interactions remain version-sensitive.
